name: Driven Affairs
source:
Driven Affairs is a visual novel where you take the role of chauffeur in New York city, drive your Bentley around, and build relationships with your sexy and wealthy clients!

[Edited from an [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/driven-affairs-49106946]unofficial Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在视觉小说《Driven Affairs》中，你将扮演纽约市的一名专职司机，开着宾利四处奔走，与性感富有的客户们建立关系！

[编译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/driven-affairs-49106946]非官方Patreon页面[/url]]
